notes.content: Minimum grade of c- in major courses
Students must earn a minimum grade of C- in all courses taken to fulfill the major requirements; and must earn a minimum overall GPA of 2.0 in the major.

notes.content: In the lower division core requirements, students choose between ESM 230-Environmental Methods or an upper division course (see the University Catalog for details). Students choosing to take ESM 230 after transferring to HSU should be aware this course has a prerequisite of major course GEOG 106 (or ESM 105) as well as STAT 109 which is not required elsewhere in the major. See the Optional Prerequisite Courses section at the end of this agreement to view transferable statistics courses which will meet this prerequisite.
